title: ClearPath Tier Minimums for Late Charges on Microsoft 365 Annual Invoices
content:
**Minimum schedule.** The late-charge minimum on a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) annual cycle invoice follows the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services schedule. The minimum is the figure that the percentage of the past-due balance is compared against.

- With an active ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise agreement, the minimum is **50.00 USD**.
- With an active ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional agreement, the minimum is **35.00 USD**.
- Otherwise, no ClearPath minimum applies.

The tier and the status are read from the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement record.

| Client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement | Late-charge minimum |
|---|---|
| Active, ClearPath Enterprise | 50.00 USD |
| Active, ClearPath Premier | 50.00 USD |
| Active, ClearPath Professional | 35.00 USD |
| Active, ClearPath Standard | 35.00 USD |
| Active, ClearPath Essentials or ClearPath Monitor | no ClearPath minimum |
| Not active (for example under notice or closed), or no agreement | no ClearPath minimum |

## Points of judgement

- Only an active agreement sets a ClearPath minimum. A ClearPath Premier agreement under notice does not.
- Example with a hypothetical 1 percent rate: on a past-due balance of 4000.00 USD the percentage figure is 40.00. Against a 35.00 minimum, the 40.00 percentage figure applies. Against a 50.00 minimum, the minimum of 50.00 applies.
